Completed ASM acquisition, including Korean plant
Adds operating rare earth metal and alloy capabilities to the company's mine-to-magnet strategy.
VAC acquisition expected to close in Q1 2027
The deal remains pending; completion would be the next step in the stated supply-chain strategy.
Approved construction of commercial-scale HREO circuits
Construction approval advances planned heavy rare earth oxide capacity, but timing and output were not provided.

This is a strategic execution update within Energy Fuels' effort to build an integrated rare earth supply chain, rather than a late confirmation of a completed buildout. Progress on construction and closing the pending VAC acquisition would be needed to establish the next stage of commercial capacity.
